findings.title: Operation Economic Outcast Severs MEXC Global's Access to the U.S. Financial System
findings.summary_md: FinCEN issued an order under section 9714(a) of the Combating Russian Money Laundering Act cutting MEXC Global off from the US financial system. The order finds the Seychelles-based exchange facilitated at least $16 billion in illicit transactions tied to Iranian, North Korean, and Russian sanctions evasion and cybercrime between May 2021 and May 2026. FinCEN announced the action as part of Operation Economic Outcast.

findings.title: Operation Economic Outcast Severs MEXC Global's Access to the U.S. Financial System
findings.summary_md: The Treasury Department announced a section 9714(a) order prohibiting US financial institutions from engaging in any transmittal of funds from or to MEXC Global. The action is part of Operation Economic Outcast and targets the exchange over sanctions evasion and cybercrime links. Treasury said MEXC was still processing transactions with sanctioned Russian entities as recently as June 2026.

findings.title: FinCEN order cuts MEXC Global off the US funds system
findings.summary_md: FinCEN's order cuts MEXC Global off US funds transfers after finding the exchange moved at least $16 billion in illicit flows tied to sanctions evasion and cybercrime. FinCEN issued the order on November 6, 2026, and US financial institutions must stop processing transfers involving the exchange. The order relies on section 9714 of the Combating Russian Money Laundering Act.
